description: composer.json fallback when no composer.lock exists: require/require-dev parsed at Medium confidence (declared ranges, never resolved, so every purl is version-less -- a pkg:composer/...@^7.8 could never match an OSV/CPE record), require-dev => scope: "excluded"; php/ext-* platform entries are skipped and counted, which is this case's exit 1 (NOT the "found composer.json ... with no lockfile alongside" warning, which no longer fires now that composer.json is one of composer's supported names); a composer.json under vendor/ (an installed package's own) leaks nothing, so psr/log must be absent -- the only non-composer component is the unrelated generic vendor/acme find
